review_evidence: README explicitly identifies the project as a formalisation of WebAssembly semantics in Lean, organized by Syntax, Validation, Dynamics, Binary and Text components mirroring the WebAssembly specification.
The 42 retained Wasm modules define the formal syntax/runtime/validation relations and include checked facts for values, vector lengths, typing context wellformedness and translation helpers.
Main.lean is a CLI that reads a .wasm file and invokes retained parser/printer functions; lakefile.lean only configures package, executable and dependencies.

rules.content_invariant: All syntax, validation, dynamic semantics, binary/text definitions and checked facts remain under retained Wasm/; Main merely wires them to filesystem/CLI output and the lakefile configures dependencies/targets.
evidence: Complete Main.lean and lakefile.lean inspected directly.
rules.rationale: These exact files are command-line I/O and build configuration, not the WebAssembly semantic/specification library.

summary: Reviewed WasmLean; retain the WebAssembly syntax, validation, dynamics, binary/text formats and checked helper facts, while excluding only the command-line converter and Lake build configuration.
